high_level_description: This image captures a serene urban street scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, as indicated by the warm, reddish-orange hues in the sky. The sky is filled with soft clouds, adding depth and texture to the backdrop. The street is lined with buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of architectural styles. The buildings are mostly dark, silhouetted against the vibrant sky, suggesting it might be early morning or late evening. There are a few illuminated windows, hinting at activity inside some of the apartments.
